supplements.title: Cannabinoids in the Treatment of Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
supplements.summary: Cannabinoids showed no significant benefit over placebo for treating chemotherapy-induced nerve pain in limited clinical trials.

supplements.title: Redox rewiring in glioblastoma: the thioredoxin system as a precision therapeutic target.
supplements.summary: Targeting the thioredoxin system in glioblastoma tumors could overcome drug resistance and improve treatment outcomes.

supplements.title: Targeting the PI3K/Akt/mTOR and Nrf2 signaling axis with berberine: a novel strategy for attenuating diabetic cardiomyopathy.
supplements.summary: Berberine combined with insulin effectively treats diabetic heart disease by reducing inflammation, oxidative stress, and improving heart function through specific cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Gastrointestinal symptoms in Parkinson's disease treated in a controlled trial using traditional Chinese medicine (Jia-Wei-Ji-Chuan-Jian decoction) with network pharmacology analysis of active agents and mechanism of action.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese medicine decoction improved gastrointestinal symptoms in Parkinson's disease patients through multiple active compounds.

supplements.title: Synthesis of Sericin-Based Stretchable and Self-healing Hydrogel Loaded With Psidium guajava L. Extract for Treatment of Burn Wound.
supplements.summary: A sericin-based hydrogel with guava extract significantly accelerated burn wound healing in mice, achieving 90% closure by day 15.

supplements.title: Gut microbiota and diet in colorectal cancer: Converging determinants of carcinogenesis.
supplements.summary: Diet shapes gut bacteria in ways that either increase or decrease colorectal cancer risk through inflammation and metabolic changes.

supplements.title: Micheliolide ameliorates colon cancer cachexia by modulating gut microbiota-immune signaling via Phocaeicola vulgatus enrichment.
supplements.summary: Micheliolide reduces colon cancer cachexia by enriching beneficial gut bacteria and strengthening immune signaling.

supplements.title: Curcumin Alleviates Bone Cancer Pain by Inhibiting Satellite Glial Cell Activity via Janus Kinase 1/Signal Transducer and Transcription 3 Pathway Activator.
supplements.summary: Curcumin relieves bone cancer pain by blocking a specific cellular pathway that reduces inflammation and nerve cell activation.

supplements.title: l-Proline as a safer strategy to preserve ovarian function for patients facing gonadotoxic therapies.
supplements.summary: L-proline offers a safer, DMSO-free method to preserve ovarian function in cancer patients undergoing gonadotoxic therapies.

supplements.title: Chrysophanol ameliorates ferroptosis in acute kidney injury by promoting SIRT3-mediated NRF2 deacetylation.
supplements.summary: Chrysophanol protects against acute kidney injury by preventing ferroptosis through a SIRT3-NRF2 protein pathway.

supplements.title: Computational and experimental elucidation of ginsenoside Rh2 as a FAK-targeted inhibitor of tumor cell invasion and migration.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside Rh2, a natural compound, blocks cancer cell invasion and migration by inhibiting FAK protein activation.

supplements.title: Cauloside A interacts with TLR4 to induce JNK/Caspase-3/GSDME-dependent pyroptosis in non-small cell lung cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Cauloside A, a natural compound, kills non-small cell lung cancer cells by binding TLR4 and triggering a cell death pathway.

supplements.title: The protective role of whole grains and legumes against gastric cancer.
supplements.summary: Eating whole grains and legumes may reduce gastric cancer risk by lowering inflammation and oxidative stress through beneficial compounds.

supplements.title: Efficient pulmonary-targeted therapy and mechanistic insights of a novel glutathione dry powder inhaler in a model of radiation-induced lung injury.
supplements.summary: A new inhaled glutathione powder effectively treats radiation-induced lung injury by reducing oxidative stress and cell death in mice.

supplements.title: Chitosan loaded copper and selenium nanoparticles synergistically inhibit HepG2-hepatic cancer cells viability and angiogenesis.
supplements.summary: Copper-selenium nanoparticles kill liver cancer cells and prevent blood vessel growth, offering potential new treatment approach.

off_label.title: UBA2-High Osteosarcoma Suppresses Immune Infiltration by Autophagy-Mediated MHC-I Degradation.
off_label.summary: UBA2 protein drives osteosarcoma's immune resistance by triggering autophagy that destroys MHC-I, blocking immune cell infiltration and checkpoint therapy response.

off_label.title: Redox rewiring in glioblastoma: the thioredoxin system as a precision therapeutic target.
off_label.summary: Targeting the thioredoxin system in glioblastoma tumors could overcome drug resistance and improve treatment outcomes.

off_label.title: Targeting NDUFS4 Disrupts Oxidative Phosphorylation and Induces Ferroptosis in Olaparib-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking NDUFS4 in olaparib-resistant prostate cancer restores drug sensitivity by disrupting mitochondrial function and triggering ferroptosis.

off_label.title: RAPTOR Silencing Inhibits Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma Progression via Regulation of S100A8/A9 and Urokinase Plasminogen Activator.
off_label.summary: Silencing RAPTOR protein inhibits head and neck cancer progression by reducing tumor-promoting signals and increasing protective immune proteins.

off_label.title: An Open-label, Two-arm, Multicenter, Phase II Randomized Controlled Trial Assessing the Impact of Olanzapine on the Efficacy of First-line Immunotherapy in Patients With Advanced EGFR Mutation-negative Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC).
off_label.summary: Study tests whether adding olanzapine to immunotherapy improves outcomes in advanced lung cancer patients compared to immunotherapy alone.

off_label.title: A novel combination for in vivo breast cancer treatment: TAK1 inhibition combined with metformin and Lentinula edodes compounds synergistically reinvigorates CD8+ T Cells.
off_label.summary: Combining a TAK1 inhibitor, metformin, and mushroom extract boosts immune cells to fight triple-negative breast cancer in mice.

off_label.title: The role of nimodipine in preventing cerebral ischaemia and neurological deterioration in cerebral arteriovenous malformations: a systematic review.
off_label.summary: Nimodipine may help prevent brain damage from blood vessel spasms in patients with arteriovenous malformations, though evidence remains unclear.

off_label.title: Repurposing Drugs for Malaria through a Human Dose Prediction: A Case Study with Berzosertib.
off_label.summary: Researchers predict that an anticancer drug called berzosertib could treat malaria at safe doses lower than those used for cancer therapy.

off_label.title: Loss of JAK1 Function Causes G2-M Cell-Cycle Defects Vulnerable to KIF18A Inhibition.
off_label.summary: Blocking JAK1 in head and neck cancer makes tumors resistant to radiation, but adding a KIF18A inhibitor overcomes this resistance.

off_label.title: Delivery of nano-formulated drugs to solid tumours is selectively increased by co-application of the vascular disrupting agent CA4P.
off_label.summary: Combining a vascular-disrupting agent with nano-formulated drugs significantly improves drug delivery to solid tumors.

off_label.title: Rosuvastatin enhances the efficacy of venetoclax-azacitidine in older acute myeloid leukemia patients via reducing T-cell exhaustion.
off_label.summary: Adding rosuvastatin to venetoclax-azacitidine improves treatment response in older AML patients by reducing T-cell exhaustion.

off_label.title: Lipophilic Statins Deplete GPX4 to Promote Ferroptosis and Sensitize Cancer Cells to Immune Checkpoint Blockade.
off_label.summary: Lipophilic statins kill melanoma and colorectal cancer cells by depleting a protective protein, and combining them with immunotherapy cures tumors in most mice.

off_label.title: Mineralocorticoid and glucocorticoid receptor cooperation drives advanced phenotypes in triple-negative breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Two receptor proteins working together drive aggressive triple-negative breast cancer; blocking this interaction reduced tumor spread in mice.

off_label.title: Downregulation of claudin-2 expression and chemoresistance by saquinavir in human lung adenocarcinoma cells.
off_label.summary: Saquinavir, an HIV drug, reduces a protein called claudin-2 in lung adenocarcinoma cells, making them more sensitive to chemotherapy.

off_label.title: Angiotensin II Type 1 Receptor Blockade Inhibits Gastric Cancer Metastasis Through Tight Junction Restoration.
off_label.summary: Blocking angiotensin II signaling restores cell junctions and prevents gastric cancer metastasis in preclinical models.

biomarkers.title: Altered crosstalk of bacterial lipopolysaccharide with immune cells in colorectal cancer compared to paired adjacent intestinal tissue.
biomarkers.summary: Bacterial toxins interact differently with immune cells in colorectal cancer tumors versus healthy nearby tissue, potentially affecting immune responses.

biomarkers.title: Rab5 improves CAR T cell efficacy via reducing fratricide and maintaining surface CAR levels.
biomarkers.summary: Adding Rab5 protein to CAR T cells improves their cancer-fighting ability by reducing self-destruction and maintaining tumor-targeting receptors.

biomarkers.title: TACI regulates marginal zone B cell development.
biomarkers.summary: TACI protein is required for developing marginal zone B cells through a specific cellular pathway involving PI3K-AKT and FOXO1 regulation.

biomarkers.title: FTO promotes bladder cancer progression and stemness-associated phenotypes.
biomarkers.summary: FTO protein promotes bladder cancer growth and stem cell properties; blocking it suppresses tumor progression in mice.

biomarkers.title: Integrative genomic and functional characterization of ADAMTS3 reveals its inflammatory regulation via NF-κB and STAT3 pathways in osteosarcoma.
biomarkers.summary: ADAMTS-3 protein is overexpressed in osteosarcoma and drives tumor growth through inflammatory pathways, offering a new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: ATP2B1 expression identifies human hematopoietic stem cells with superior repopulation and self-renewal.
biomarkers.summary: ATP2B1 protein identifies the most capable human blood-forming stem cells with superior growth and self-renewal abilities.

biomarkers.title: Stag2-mediated chromatin dynamics regulates antibody class switch recombination.
biomarkers.summary: Stag2 protein is essential for antibody diversity by regulating how B cells rearrange their DNA during immune response and cancer development.

biomarkers.title: VEGF-D-induced intraosseous lymphangiogenesis drives site-specific heterotopic bone resorption.
biomarkers.summary: VEGF-D protein promotes lymphatic vessel growth that triggers bone resorption, offering a potential treatment for abnormal bone formation after injury.

biomarkers.title: Renal Cell Carcinoma With Concurrent Loss of SMARCB1/INI-1 and Fumarate Hydratase By Immunohistochemistry: A Case Report With Review of the Literature.
biomarkers.summary: A rare kidney cancer case showed loss of two key proteins; one had a mutation while the other's loss appeared epigenetically caused.

biomarkers.title: Revisiting RAS family GTPase signaling: effector selectivity and oncogenic bypass.
biomarkers.summary: Oncogenic RAS mutations override normal protein selectivity rules, enabling RAS to activate multiple downstream pathways simultaneously in cancer cells.

biomarkers.title: Histone modification cross-talk: analytical tools and molecular mechanisms.
biomarkers.summary: Histone modifications influence each other through epigenetic cross-talk, affecting how enzymes regulate chromatin structure and gene activity.

biomarkers.title: Use of hydrogen deuterium exchange mass spectrometry in tandem with modern structural biology.
biomarkers.summary: HDX-MS technology, combined with structural biology methods, validates AI protein predictions and reveals how proteins interact and change shape.

biomarkers.title: Real-World Analysis of Adverse Events in Patients With Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Receiving Therapy per KEYNOTE-522.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that combining chemotherapy with pembrolizumab effectively treats early-stage triple-negative breast cancer, with manageable side effects in real-world patients.

biomarkers.title: Neoadjuvant Single-Cycle Pembrolizumab for Stage I-III MMR-Deficient Colon Cancer: The RESET-C Trial.
biomarkers.summary: A single dose of pembrolizumab before surgery shows promise for treating early-stage colon cancer with mismatch repair deficiency.

biomarkers.title: Potent anti-tumor activity of the AXL-targeted antibody-drug conjugate, mipasetamab uzoptirine (ADCT-601), in preclinical models of adenoid cystic carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: An experimental drug targeting AXL protein shows promise in killing adenoid cystic carcinoma cells in laboratory and animal models.

trials.title: Rab5 improves CAR T cell efficacy via reducing fratricide and maintaining surface CAR levels.
trials.summary: Adding Rab5 protein to CAR T cells improves their cancer-fighting ability by reducing self-destruction and maintaining tumor-targeting receptors.

trials.title: Pde4 mediates MHCII expression in oligodendroglia.
trials.summary: Blocking PDE4 signaling reduces immune activation in brain cells and alleviates stress-related depression symptoms in mice.

trials.title: Real-World Analysis of Adverse Events in Patients With Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Receiving Therapy per KEYNOTE-522.
trials.summary: Researchers found that combining chemotherapy with pembrolizumab effectively treats early-stage triple-negative breast cancer, with manageable side effects in real-world patients.

trials.title: Perioperative Toripalimab Plus Chemotherapy Versus Chemotherapy Alone in Locally Advanced Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction Cancer: 3-Year Follow-Up of NEOSUMMIT-01 Trial.
trials.summary: Adding toripalimab immunotherapy to chemotherapy improved survival outcomes in locally advanced gastric cancer patients compared to chemotherapy alone.

trials.title: Attitudes and Willingness to Participate in Drug Clinical Trials Among Patients With Cancer: Multistage Qualitative Study.
trials.summary: Study reveals patient attitudes toward cancer clinical trials in China, identifying barriers and facilitators to improve recruitment strategies.

trials.title: Neoadjuvant Single-Cycle Pembrolizumab for Stage I-III MMR-Deficient Colon Cancer: The RESET-C Trial.
trials.summary: A single dose of pembrolizumab before surgery shows promise for treating early-stage colon cancer with mismatch repair deficiency.

trials.title: Safety and efficacy of allogeneic CD19-directed CAR-T therapy CTX110 in relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
trials.summary: CTX110, an allogeneic CAR-T cell therapy, achieved a 65% response rate in heavily treated relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma patients with manageable side effects.

trials.title: Metastatic Trajectories in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Guide Local and Systemic Therapies.
trials.summary: Tracking how individual lung cancer tumors respond differently over time can guide personalized treatment decisions combining surgery, radiation, and systemic therapy.

trials.title: GSH-Responsive Nanoparticles Enhance Hepatocellular Carcinoma Immunotherapy Through Synergistic Effects of Cuproptosis and PI3K Inhibitor Combination.
trials.summary: Nanoparticles combining copper-induced cell death and PI3K inhibitor effectively treat hepatocellular carcinoma by activating immune responses against tumors.

trials.title: Polatuzumab vedotin-containing regimens as bridge to CART: analysis from the CART-SIE study.
trials.summary: For large B-cell lymphoma, polatuzumab vedotin with rituximab alone works as well as with bendamustine before CAR-T therapy, with fewer side effects.

trials.title: Combining Menin and MEK inhibition to target poor prognosis KMT2A-rearranged RAS pathway-mutant acute myeloid leukemia.
trials.summary: Combining menin and MEK inhibitors shows promise for treating aggressive childhood acute myeloid leukemia with specific genetic mutations.

trials.title: Cannabinoids in the Treatment of Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
trials.summary: Cannabinoids showed no significant benefit over placebo for treating chemotherapy-induced nerve pain in limited clinical trials.

trials.title: Reengineered Albumin-Paclitaxel Nanoparticles Remodeling Tumor Cell Death Pathways for Prevention of Chemotherapy-Induced Breast Cancer Metastasis.
trials.summary: New nanoparticles deliver cancer drugs plus inhibitors to prevent triple-negative breast cancer from spreading during chemotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Detection of cytokine release syndrome using wearables and cytokine profiling following CAR-T therapy for myeloma.
trials.summary: Wearable devices may help detect dangerous side effects from CAR-T myeloma therapy, potentially allowing safer outpatient treatment.

trials.title: The density of tumour infiltrating lymphocytes in oesophago-gastric cancer varies with disease stage, geographical region and treatment: a post hoc analysis of nine phase III clinical trials.
trials.summary: Immune cell density in esophageal and gastric cancers varies significantly by disease stage, geographic location, and treatment type.
